chapter.subject: Social Science
source_key_points: 2 CHAPTER Oceans and Continents The ocean is everything.
It is an immense desert, where man is never lonely, for he feels life stirring all around.
The globe began with the ocean, so to speak, and who knows if it will not end with it.
In what ways do oceans and continents impact life on Earth, including human life?
2.1 The Earth seen from space (photograph by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter).
The view is centred on the Indian Ocean, with Africa to the left, India and part of Asia at the top, Australia to the right, and Antarctica at the bottom.
